engines.strata: 0.1.57 engine, used for the Flash-Next quality run and its 256K check on 2026-11-05

flash_next.quality_run: the archived run of 2026-11-05 on Strata: context 262,144, int8 KV, one slot, vision off; see /benchmarks/qwen38-strata-5090-20261105/
flash_next.server_on_basalt: its usual configuration: four slots that share a 1,048,576-token context, int8 KV, images on. The harness sent one request at a time.
flash_next.sampling: temperature 0 on the core cases and HumanEval; temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, min_p 0, reasoning effort xhigh on the focused reruns; temperature 0.6 on the speed probes
flash_next.gsm8k: 195 of the first 200 problems, greedy, thinking on, one request at a time, on Basalt on 2026-11-24

inkling_2_mini.weights: the official release: NVFP4 experts for layers 0 to 19 and MXFP8 for layers 20 to 23, kept bit for bit; attention, gate, convolution and output projections 8-bit
inkling_2_mini.server_on_basalt: context 262,144, one slot, drafting on (DSpark), images on; KV cache int8 in the first runs and fp16 in the later ones, as measurements.json records per run
inkling_2_mini.server_on_llama_cpp: ctx-size 65,536; one slot; f16 KV cache; every layer on the GPU; no drafter
inkling_2_mini.sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k 0, min_p 0, as the publisher recommends; seed 729 in the first two runs and 730 in the third
inkling_2_mini.thinking_off_means: reasoning effort none, the lowest level; the model still writes a short reasoning block
inkling_2_mini.gsm8k: 194 of the first 200 problems, greedy, thinking on, one request at a time, on Basalt

limitations: Small fixed suites, not a general quality ranking. Inkling answers are sampled, so its scores are ranges over three runs. Flash-Next was run once, at temperature 0, and its quality numbers come from another engine with the same weights. GSM8K is compared on totals only. The 256K check is a three-marker recall smoke test. No claim is made about sustained agent sessions, multi-day stability, or generation speed at a full context.
